claims.claim: The explicit prospective_runtime seam uses the existing RuntimeCompletion and ExecutorBoundary within one selected PRIMARY adapter invocation. Default dispatch, correction dispatch, terminal ownership and historical verification policies retain their existing paths without another Executor or lifecycle owner.

Consumption freshly authenticates ACTIVE TASK/revision/RUN/operation/base/candidate/tree, reviewed complete proof mapping, latest sealed K_i and original captures. Original F_i bytes and digest are rechecked around confirmation, persistence and replay; stale, projected or altered sources cannot acknowledge.

Live consumption requires the exact original registry-held lease, adapter, boundary, Runtime owner, active execution thread/frame and available profile. Released, copied, reacquired, cross-RUN, detached or reconstructed sessions cannot establish liveness or invoke native execution again.

Receipt identity binds authenticated K_i/F_i, admitted Executor and protected Runtime/invocation identities. Only the same adapter's direct typed confirmation establishes local acknowledgment; output and F_i retain denied production delivery, C2 and continuation authority.

Exact replay authenticates immutable receipt bytes and retained callback lineage without another callback, proof execution, adapter invocation or resource debit. Collisions, changed sources and interrupted or ambiguous effects preserve the original fence and latch STOP.

Progress requires prior local consumption of native FAIL, an authenticated changed scoped committed descendant, unchanged complete proof conditions and strict reduction of outstanding obligations. Dirty, empty, unrelated, stale or inconclusive candidates cannot establish progress; C2 remains denied.

Assessments remain STOP with Human opt-in and token budget NOT_ESTABLISHED. Exhausted known resource limits block exposure; missing session/source/operation authority blocks consumption. Requests accept no caller consent, budget, policy, Executor choice or progress assertion.

Terminal records/intents, revoked sources, contention and unknown effects exclude further authority. The repaired before/partial/complete crash test requires zero native execution and feedback exposure, unchanged retained bytes/timestamps, only the exact contested.json witness, and an unchanged snapshot after another reconstructed blocked attempt.

Non-PRIMARY consumption returns CORRECTION_NATIVE_AUTHORITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED. REPAIR and REMEDIATION retain independent dispatch paths and cannot inherit PRIMARY acknowledgment through caller-supplied correction lineage, findings or authorization.

Frozen typed records use deterministic closed schemas, canonical nested validation, bounded decoding and consistent identities/counters. Consumption serialization contains factual bindings and guarded status, excluding raw logs, secrets, executable instructions, patches, commands and invented authority.

Focused regression definitions use real Git/native K_i/F_i captures and actual RunLeaseRegistry/ExecutorBoundary integration. Coverage includes same-holder acknowledgment, full mapping, replay, holder/adapter replacement, source corruption, terminal contention, crash ambiguity, missing consent/budget, absent progress and correction spoofing; existing definitions remain intact.

The admitted candidate remains within the eight authorized TASK paths; this repair changes only the authorized continuation test. Native codecs directly delegate to canonical validators without Runtime initialization. Cold-import positive/malformed-input coverage and AST dependency, side-effect and validator-bypass negatives remain present. Documentation preserves L3-01/02/03 and V1/V2 boundaries and separates preactivation L3-04 from L3-05, L3-06/G3, G6 and L4.
